title: Apple Inc. (AAPL) is Piedmont Investment Advisors LLC’s Largest Position -
text:
Piedmont Investment Advisors LLC trimmed its holdings in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 58.3% during the second quarter, according to the company in its most recent filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission. The fund owned 382,400 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 535,029 shares during the period. Apple accounts for approximately 3.4% of Piedmont Investment Advisors LLC’s holdings, making the stock its largest holding. Piedmont Investment Advisors LLC’s holdings in Apple were worth $70,786,000 as of its most recent SEC filing.
A number of other large investors have also modified their holdings of AAPL. B. Riley Financial Inc. lifted its stake in shares of Apple by 27.6% in the 1st quarter. B. Riley Financial Inc. now owns 17,412 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $2,921,000 after purchasing an additional 3,770 shares in the last quarter. First Hawaiian Bank lifted its stake in shares of Apple by 33.5% in the 2nd quarter. First Hawaiian Bank now owns 10,012 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $1,854,000 after purchasing an additional 2,510 shares in the last quarter. Roof Advisory Group Inc. lifted its stake in shares of Apple by 44.0% in the 1st quarter. Roof Advisory Group Inc. now owns 42,322 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $7,101,000 after purchasing an additional 12,930 shares in the last quarter. Peavine Capital LLC lifted its stake in shares of Apple by 428.7% in the 2nd quarter. Peavine Capital LLC now owns 6,968 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $1,290,000 after purchasing an additional 5,650 shares in the last quarter. Finally, Nikulski Financial Inc. lifted its stake in shares of Apple by 1.6% in the 1st quarter. Nikulski Financial Inc. now owns 26,051 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $4,371,000 after purchasing an additional 407 shares in the last quarter. 58.35% of the stock is currently owned by hedge funds and other institutional investors. In other Apple news, CEO Timothy D. Cook sold 265,160 shares of Apple stock in a transaction that occurred on Monday, August 27th. The stock was sold at an average price of $217.79, for a total transaction of $57,749,196.40. The transaction was disclosed in a filing with the SEC, which is available through this link . Also, insider Johny Srouji sold 14,140 shares of Apple stock in a transaction that occurred on Friday, August 17th. The stock was sold at an average price of $214.98, for a total value of $3,039,817.20. Following the sale, the insider now owns 68,302 shares in the company, valued at $14,683,563.96. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Insiders have sold a total of 480,737 shares of company stock worth $107,157,170 over the last 90 days. 0.06% of the stock is owned by company insiders.
AAPL stock opened at $194.17 on Tuesday. The company has a current ratio of 1.12, a quick ratio of 1.09 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.87. Apple Inc. has a 52-week low of $150.24 and a 52-week high of $233.47. The company has a market cap of $1,005.00 billion, a price-to-earnings ratio of 16.30, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.47 and a beta of 1.26.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last posted its quarterly earnings data on Thursday, November 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.91 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, topping the consensus estimate of $2.78 by $0.13. Apple had a return on equity of 48.68% and a net margin of 22.41%. The company had revenue of $62.90 billion for the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $61.55 billion. During the same period in the previous year, the business earned $2.07 EPS. Apple’s revenue for the quarter was up 19.6% compared to the same quarter last year. On average, equities analysts forecast that Apple Inc. will post 13.35 EPS for the current fiscal year.
The firm also recently disclosed a quarterly dividend, which will be paid on Thursday, November 15th. Shareholders of record on Monday, November 12th will be issued a dividend of $0.73 per share. The ex-dividend date of this dividend is Thursday, November 8th. This represents a $2.92 annualized dividend and a yield of 1.50%. Apple’s dividend payout ratio is presently 24.52%.
Several equities analysts have recently weighed in on the company. Atlantic Securities reaffirmed a “neutral” rating and issued a $205.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a research note on Wednesday, August 1st. BidaskClub lowered Apple from a “buy” rating to a “hold” rating in a research note on Tuesday. Macquarie reaffirmed a “buy” rating and issued a $222.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a research note on Monday, November 5th. BMO Capital Markets raised their target price on Apple from $184.00 to $199.00 and gave the company a “market perform” rating in a report on Wednesday, August 1st. They noted that the move was a valuation call. Finally, Wells Fargo & Co reiterated a “neutral” rating and set a $210.00 target price on shares of Apple in a report on Monday, October 29th. Three analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, twenty-one have assigned a hold rating and twenty-seven have assigned a buy rating to the company’s stock. The stock has an average rating of “Hold” and an average price target of $225.07.
